meta.name: The Master
meta.description: Freddie, a volatile, heavy-drinking veteran who suffers from post-traumatic stress disorder, finds some semblance of a family when he stumbles onto the ship of Lancaster Dodd, the charismatic leader of a new "religion" he forms after World War II.
meta.slogan: Haunted by his past, a World War II veteran crosses paths with a mysterious movement called The Cause.
